item.title: Audit Manager
item.description:
We’re Gravita: the accountants fuelling ambitious businesses. We’re a full service, tech-enabled firm, working with entrepreneurs and businesses to help them achieve their goals, and make an impact in the world.

We’re growing fast and are bringing like-minded advisors together to form a full-service tech-enabled accounting partner for thousands of SMEs. Our team use their incredible expertise alongside intuitive technology to help businesses and entrepreneurs plan better and grow faster.

Our mission is to become the UK’s leading tech-enabled accounting firm for SMEs. We have ambitious goals and our high-calibre team work hard to achieve them. We are one team with one agenda, working collaboratively in a respectful environment to deliver a great service to our clients. So if you join us, you’ll not only be working on exciting client challenges, you’ll also be helping us shape the future of accounting.

The Role

As an Audit Manager, you'll play a key role in leading and delivering high-quality audits, managing client relationships, and the performance of audit team members. Working closely with Associate Directors, Directors and Partners, you'll help ensure engagements are delivered on time, on budget, and to the highest professional standards.

  • You'll manage a portfolio of corporate and charity clients, acting as a key point of contact throughout the audit process.

  • You'll plan, lead and deliver audits, ensuring work is completed on time, within budget, and to a high technical standard.

  • You'll review audit work, provide technical guidance to junior team members, and ensure compliance with firm methodology and regulatory requirements.

  • You'll build strong relationships with clients, delivering excellent service and supporting them with their audit and accounting requirements.

  • You'll coach, develop and mentor Associates and Senior Associates, helping them grow their technical and professional skills.

  • You'll identify opportunities to support existing clients and contribute to the continued growth of the Audit & Assurance team.

Qualifications, Knowledge & Experience:

We're looking for an ACA or ACCA qualified Audit Manager with experience leading audits across a portfolio of corporate clients and experience developing strong client relationships. You'll also:

  • Have experience managing audit assignments from planning through to completion within an accountancy practice environment.

  • Be confident building relationships with business owners, finance teams and other key stakeholders.

  • Have strong technical audit and accounting knowledge, with experience reviewing the work of junior team members.

  • Demonstrate excellent organisational and project management skills, balancing multiple priorities effectively.

  • Enjoy coaching and developing others, creating an environment where people can learn and grow.

  • Be commercially aware, recognising opportunities to strengthen client relationships and support business growth.

  • Value feedback and continuous improvement, contributing positively to a collaborative team culture.

  • Be comfortable working effectively in a hybrid environment, both remotely and in the office.


Your Career with Gravita

When you join Gravita, we’ll support you on your own growth journey. We want to be the place you learn, grow and unlock your true potential.

We’ll work with you to build a progression plan to outline how you’ll grow at our company and everything we’ll do to help you get there. We’re also passionate about learning and development, to help you focus on your future.


The Key Details

  • Our standard working week is a 37.5-hour week on a hybrid basis

  • Core working hours are 10am - 4pm Monday to Friday

  • Flexible working and happy employees are at the top of our list here at Gravita and we have been working hard to support our teams through the fast-paced changes.

  • Your development won’t be forgotten, our development support is extraordinary for a firm of our size.

  • It's a busy, fast-paced environment here at Gravita. Feel free to check out our social media channels (Instagram, X, LinkedIn and Glassdoor).

As a Director or Partner within our Private Client team, you play a pivotal role in the delivery and growth of a high-quality advisory offering for entrepreneurs, business owners, high-net-worth individuals and families.

You will advise clients on complex personal tax matters while helping them navigate significant life and business events. This includes succession planning, wealth preservation and broader family tax planning strategies.

This role is focused on developing client relationships, helping growing the service line, generating new opportunities and being part of a market-leading advisory team. Working closely with colleagues across Gravita service offerings, you will ensure clients receive holistic advice tailored to their long-term goals.

Client Advisory & Relationship Management

  • Act as a trusted advisor on complex private client advisory matters.

  • Provide strategic tax planning advice to high-net-worth individuals, families, entrepreneurs and business owners.

  • Advise on succession planning, inheritance tax planning, wealth transition strategies and other tax affairs in relation to individuals.

  • Support clients throughout key life events, including business disposals, exits, retirement and intergenerational wealth transfers.

  • Build trusted, long-term relationships with clients and their wider professional advisers.

Growth & Business Development

  • Support the growth and development of the Private Client service line.

  • Identify opportunities to expand relationships across the existing client base.

  • Build strong referral networks with lawyers, wealth managers, family offices and other professional intermediaries.

  • Support the development of Gravita's market presence within the private client sector.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Mentor, coach and develop a growing team of private client specialists.

  • Foster a culture of collaboration, technical excellence and continuous learning.

  • Support recruitment and succession planning across the team.

  • Provide technical guidance and oversight on complex client matters.

  • Act as a visible leader within the wider Tax function.

Strategic & Commercial Leadership

  • Contribute to the strategic direction and growth plans of the Private Client tax business.

  • Drive revenue growth, profitability and client retention.

  • Oversee quality, risk management and technical standards across the team.

  • Work collaboratively with colleagues across the firm to deliver integrated client solutions.

  • Champion exceptional client service and continuous improvement.

Qualifications, Knowledge & Experience:

  • CTA and/or ACA, ACCA qualified

  • Experience advising private clients within an accountancy practice, private client consultancy or professional services environment.

  • Strong technical expertise across personal tax, trusts, inheritance tax and family succession planning.

  • Experience advising entrepreneurs, owner-managed businesses, high-net-worth individuals and family groups.

  • Proven ability to lead complex advisory assignments and manage senior client relationships.

  • Good ability to generating opportunities within existing client base and support winning new clients.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

  • Commercial, strategic and client-focused approach with a passion for delivering high-quality advice.

item.description:

We’re growing fast and are bringing like-minded advisors together to form a full-service tech-enabled accounting partner for thousands of SMEs. Our team use their incredible expertise alongside intuitive technology to help businesses and entrepreneurs plan better and grow faster.

Our mission is to become the UK’s leading tech-enabled accounting firm for SMEs. We have ambitious goals and our high-calibre team work hard to achieve them. We are one team with one agenda, working collaboratively in a respectful environment to deliver a great service to our clients. So if you join us, you’ll not only be working on exciting client challenges, you’ll also be helping us shape the future of accounting.

We’re reinventing the world of accounting for good! To help us achieve this, we’re looking for the next generation of forward-thinking accountants to join our Audit Service Line in Exeter.

Starting in Summer 2027, this programme combines college-based learning with hands-on, practical experience. You’ll benefit from paid study leave, and we’ll cover the cost of your exams.

Throughout the programme, you’ll receive regular check-ins and ongoing support to help you grow and succeed. Our goal is for you to join us permanently once you’ve completed your training.

The Role

At Gravita, we fuel ambitious businesses. We’re a full service, tech-enabled firm, working with entrepreneurs and businesses to help them achieve their goals, and make an impact in the world. If you join us, you won't just be going on your own exciting growth journey; you’ll become part of ours.

You’ll also:

  • Work with over 30 clients from a wide range of industries to help you gain maximum experience and accelerate your learning.

  • Get exposure to our Partners and Executive team to help you learn from the best and see key decision-makers in action.

  • Liaise directly with CEOs, CFOs, Financial Directors and entrepreneurs from some of the country’s most ambitious startups and growing businesses.

  • See how our team uses intuitive technology alongside their incredible expertise to provide an unparalleled client experience and streamline workloads.

  • Discover our premium brand dedicated to producing a Top 6 firm’s quality of work, including our listed client base.

  • Learn from our accounting experts with years of experience dedicated to SME businesses.

  • Become part of an engaged, inclusive, motivated and accountable team aligned behind shared values.

Requirements

We’re looking for talented graduates who want to learn, contribute and succeed. The ideal candidates will also embody our company values:

  • You’ll be ambitious, determined and armed with a can-do attitude. You’ll want to achieve big things, challenge the status quo and be a forward-thinker.

  • You’ll recognise the values of relationships. You’ll understand that people are the core of our business and want to build relationships based on integrity, commitment and trust.

  • You’ll care about what you do and are always eager to do your best work. You’ll be naturally conscientious, considerate and empathetic to colleagues and clients.

  • You’ll be a natural communicator. You recognise that communicating respectfully and positively is paramount, and always be open to constructive and actionable feedback.

  • You’ll enjoy working at pace and believe that momentum and precision can work harmoniously to deliver success.

We’re looking for ambitious graduates who have the following qualifications:

  • 2:1 (or equivalent) undergraduate degree in any discipline

  • Minimum Grade 5 or B GCSE Maths (or equivalent)

  • Minimum Grade 5 or B GCSE English Language (or equivalent)

  • 120 UCAS points from your top 3 grades, excluding General Studies under the 2017 tariff point system at A Level (300 UCAS points pre-2017), or equivalent.

Recruitment Process 

  1. Application - Applications open until January 2027

  2. Online Testing

  3. Video questions

  4. In-person Assessment Centre – TBC

Multiple Applications

Please only submit your application to one of our live early careers roles. Your application will be discounted if you submit it to multiple roles. We appreciate that you may have an interest in different offices or service lines, which can be discussed throughout the process. However, please submit your application to the role and location that is your preference.
